facts.form: 48 flat pre-notched strips, assembled by purchaser into a 13 ft garland

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9505 covers festive, carnival or other entertainment articles; chapter 95 notes do not exclude flimsy paper party decorations
GRI 2(a): unassembled strips have the character of the finished garland
GRI 6: 9505.90 other; 9505.90.40 confetti, paper spirals or streamers, party favors

rejected_alternatives.reason: Christmas articles; not a Christmas-specific good
decorative festive article is classified in chapter 95 as a party decoration, not as cut paper articles
other festive articles; paper garlands/streamers fit the 9505.90.40 paper streamers provision

classification.rationale: Flimsy single-use paper garland sold as party decoration is a festive article of heading 9505; similar garland and party decoration rulings (N332604, in force) place these in 9505.90.40 (paper streamers, party favors).
